facts.proposition: File System Access storage is preferred when supported.
facts.canonical: File System Access API is the preferred storage when available.
facts.paraphrase: The attachment adapter prefers filesystem storage when available.

facts.proposition: IndexedDB blob storage is the fallback.
facts.canonical: IndexedDB blob storage is the fallback.
